name: Power Distance Sort
aliases: Power Distance Sort for Delaunay Tetrahedralization
definition: A sorting method based on power distance described by Cignoni et al. and Wittenbrim. It is fast with small constant computations but not guaranteed to produce accurate visibility ordering unless the mesh is a Delaunay triangulation.
summary: Power Distance Sort orders Delaunay primitives back-to-front by comparing viewpoint power relative to circumcircles, avoiding adjacency structures.
